name: Drakuru story: Ruins of Drakil’jin
interpretationNote: Original interpretive environment illustration of Ruins of Drakil’jin, Grizzly Hills. Preserve these Wrath-era traits: Low, sprawling Drakkari burial crypts of weathered grey stone with carved tusked faces, roots and moss, enclosed by tall rust-red cedars; distinct from the high Zeb’Halak ziggurat. This is not a surveyed map, exact dungeon floor plan, or evidence of precise actor placement. Compare with the matching 3.3.5a client before human visual approval.
